configurations.name: Next.js (Node 20 via nvm, clean install)
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json .next && npm install && npm run dev

configurations.name: Next.js: dev (Node 20)
runtimeArgs: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && source "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 20 && npm run dev
